title: German B2B Data & Compliance Suite - MCP Configuration
description: Ready-to-use Model Context Protocol (MCP) server configuration connecting Claude Desktop, Cursor AI, and Windsurf to all 6 German & DACH B2B Apify Actors.

claude_desktop.instructions: Merge the 'mcpServers' configuration block into your claude_desktop_config.json and set your personal APIFY_TOKEN from https://console.apify.com/account/integrations.

cursor_ai.file_location: .cursor/mcp.json (or Cursor Settings -> Features -> MCP -> Add New MCP Server)

windsurf_cascade.instructions: Paste the 'mcpServers' block into your Windsurf MCP configuration.

available_actor_tools.name: german_e_invoice_suite
available_actor_tools.description: Generate DIN 5008 / EN 16931 ZUGFeRD 2.2 / Factur-X PDF/A-3 invoices, validate XRechnung 3.0 Schematron XML, or embed XML payloads into corporate PDF templates.
available_actor_tools.sample_prompt: Generate a compliant ZUGFeRD 2.2 Comfort PDF/A-3 invoice for Acme Corp with 10 hours IT architecture consulting.

available_actor_tools.name: german_handelsregister_kyb
available_actor_tools.description: Perform official German KYB audits via Handelsregister (XJustiz 3.5.1) and Insolvenzbekanntmachungen: extracts CEOs, registered share capital, HRB court, and active insolvency proceedings.
available_actor_tools.sample_prompt: Run a full KYB audit on 'BioNTech SE' in Mainz and check if there are any insolvency proceedings.

available_actor_tools.name: german_zvg_foreclosures
available_actor_tools.description: Scrape upcoming foreclosure auctions (Zwangsversteigerungen) from zvg-portal.de across all 16 federal states with exact market values (Verkehrswert in EUR) and official Gutachten PDF URLs.
available_actor_tools.sample_prompt: Find all commercial foreclosure auctions in Bavaria and Berlin with a market value over 250,000 EUR scheduled for the next 60 days.

available_actor_tools.name: german_public_tenders
available_actor_tools.description: Extract official German public procurement tenders and contracts from service.bund.de with CPV filters, deadlines, and direct document download links.
available_actor_tools.sample_prompt: Search service.bund.de for open IT, AI, and cloud migration tenders with deadlines in the next 4 weeks.

available_actor_tools.name: german_impressum_enricher
available_actor_tools.description: Fast § 5 DDG legal notice scraper for German & DACH domains: extracts managing directors (Geschäftsführer), de-obfuscated emails, telephone numbers, HRB court, and VAT IDs (USt-IdNr.).
available_actor_tools.sample_prompt: Enrich the domain 'celonis.com' with its registered CEO, Amtsgericht HRB number, and official VAT ID.

available_actor_tools.name: german_b2b_leads_directory
available_actor_tools.description: Extract verified German B2B company leads, local trades, crafts (Handwerker), and businesses from Gelbe Seiten & 11880 with E.164 phone numbers, addresses, and clean domains.
available_actor_tools.sample_prompt: Find 20 verified electrical contractors (Elektroinstallation) in Munich with active website domains.
